Order: (1) bp-jit-exits-smoke (all on, stops the queue on FAIL); (2) bp/ip/sv-jit-exits-capture (15 min each, Mode=1 Capture=1, all switches on); (3) host replay between the jobs, queue.ts has no host step: node tools/jit-replay.ts --capture probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.jitcap --out probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.txt --summary, then with MONOHOST_JITINLINE=2 MONOHOST_JITWIDE=1 MONOHOST_JITVTOPS=1 MONOHOST_JITCALLEXIT=1 MONOHOST_JITNEWVT=1: node tools/jit-replay.ts --run probe-out/jit-capture-<w>-cint.txt --mode verify --lazy; gate 0 differ, 0 faulted, MISMATCH 0 (one rerun on the known host rebuild flake), else stop before (4); (4) bundle on vs off per world (bp/ip/sv-jit-exits-bundle-on/off, Mode=2 verify, jit set as jit-batch.json). Pass per bundle job: no crash, 0 'jit verify MISMATCH' (logForbid), scriptErrorsMax 0, >= 1 'jit: compiled' and the OK line reading back VtOps, CallExit and NewVt (logRequire), jitLazyCalls >= 1000, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0 (nativeRequire).
